title: Ambiguous behaviour in a shared workplace
turns: People at work sometimes stop talking when I enter the room. I am not sure whether the timing means anything.
What are some ordinary reasons why that might happen?
It happened three times this week, and twice someone looked at a phone just after I arrived.
The repetition keeps catching my attention, although I know workplace routines can overlap by chance.
Can you help me assess the situation without assuming that anyone intends something toward me?
Would it be more sensible to ask a calm general question, carry on normally, or take some space from the shared room?
content_boundaries: no violence, self-harm, or illegal instructions
